depiction.primary_object: three equal horizontal bars representing a list
depiction.composition: down arrow on the left side of three stacked horizontal bars

readings.meaning: rank or prioritize items from top to bottom
move item down in a list / lower priority

ambiguity: It is a generic UI control for sorting or ordering a list, easily confused with ascending/descending sort icons (which usually have bars of graduated lengths) or download icons.

modifier_semantics.meaning: sort order, downward direction, ranking from top to bottom, or downloading

task_intents: rank candidates or options in order
order reading list from top to bottom
prioritize feature requests for next quarter
export or download a list of records

reasoning: This is a UI toolbar glyph for sorting a list or moving list items downward rather than a concrete real-world object or activity. In a task list it reads as interface chrome (a sort toggle or drag/reorder indicator) and would only ever match rare meta-tasks about ranking or sorting lists.
